description: One-command run orchestration, Makefile, README for clean-clone setup, .env.example, .gitignore, and a final integration verification pass. Corresponds to tasks.md T10 and T11. Depends on FEAT-004.
steps: scripts/run_demo.sh: create/reuse backend venv with Python 3.11 and install backend/requirements.txt; run idempotent seed (python -m finalsay.seed.seed) against SQLite default; start uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:8000 in the background of the script; cd apps/web, npm install, npm run dev (Vite on 5173) in the FOREGROUND so the parent stays alive and the backend survives. Add a --postgres flag that boots the sandbox PostgreSQL in-session (initdb if needed, start with -k /var/run/postgresql, create finalsay db/user) and exports FINALSAY_DATABASE_URL before seeding. Print the demo URLs and seeded demo user credentials.
Makefile targets: demo (calls scripts/run_demo.sh), backend (run uvicorn only), frontend (vite only), seed, test (backend pytest), eval (run harness for both splits). Use the 3.11 venv python.

README.md: project overview, architecture summary, prerequisites (Python 3.11, Node 18+), the single command to run the demo (make demo), seeded demo user credentials per role, all FINALSAY_ env switches (SQLite vs Postgres, mock vs hf model, local vs polygon anchor, confidence threshold), and notes on the Tesseract-unavailable OCR degradation. Include clean-clone steps.
.env.example listing all FINALSAY_ vars with safe defaults; .gitignore for venvs, node_modules, finalsay.db, __pycache__, dist, .env.

Final integration pass: run backend pytest suite (all green), npm run build (green), python -m finalsay.eval.harness for both splits (exit 0), and an in-process httpx/TestClient smoke of the happy path submit -> classify -> verify -> reviewer resolve. Fix any failures found.
acceptance_criteria: make test runs the full backend pytest suite green
make eval prints all metrics for both splits and exits 0
cd apps/web && npm run build succeeds
scripts/run_demo.sh exists, is executable, seeds idempotently, and documents the one-command path with no paid keys (MOCK model + LOCAL anchor default)
README documents clean-clone setup, demo users, and all env switches
verification: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split temporal && .venv/bin/python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split institution
findings: Delivered: scripts/run_demo.sh (executable, bash -n clean) — pyenv 3.11 venv create/reuse + pip install backend/requirements.txt, idempotent seed, uvicorn 127.0.0.1:8000 in background, npm install + npm run dev (Vite 5173) in FOREGROUND (not exec'd, so the EXIT/INT/TERM trap stops uvicorn + Postgres on exit); prints demo URLs + all four seeded credentials; --postgres flag boots sandbox PostgreSQL in-session (initdb only if PG_VERSION missing, -k /var/run/postgresql, listen 127.0.0.1, creates finalsay role/db if missing) and exports FINALSAY_DATABASE_URL before seeding; default path uses SQLite. Makefile targets demo/backend/frontend/seed/test/eval (+install/venv/clean/help) all use the venv python. README.md (overview, architecture, prereqs Python 3.11 + Node 18+, one-command `make demo`, demo-user table, clean-clone manual steps, Postgres section, full FINALSAY_ env-switch table, Tesseract-unavailable OCR-degradation note). .env.example with all FINALSAY_ vars at safe offline defaults. .gitignore extended with top-level dist/ and dev-dist/ (already covered venvs/node_modules/*.db/__pycache__/.pytest_cache/.env). BUG FIX: backend/finalsay/services/extraction.py deadline extractor — previously _DEADLINE_RE matched the word 'by' inside 'Issued by:' (issuer line), returning the issuer text as the deadline and driving harness deadline field-F1 to ~0.0. Refactored the date regex to expose _DATE_RE_SRC and replaced _DEADLINE_RE with a new _extract_deadline() helper: _DEADLINE_BY_RE requires a date to immediately follow the cue (register by / submit by / extended to / before / bare by) with a (?<!issued ) negative lookbehind so the issuer line never matches; _DEADLINE_EXPLICIT_RE anchors on deadline/due/last date/closes/cutoff cues and extracts the first date in the clause (short trimmed fallback otherwise). Deadline F1 is now 1.000 on both splits and correctly returns None for issuer-only notices and the real date (e.g. '16 Sep') for notices that carry both an 'Issued by:' line and a Deadline line. VERIFICATION (all green): backend `.venv/bin/pytest finalsay/tests -q` = 45 passed (no test-expectation changes needed); `.venv/bin/python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split temporal` and `--split institution` both exit 0 with deadline F1 1.000; `cd apps/web && npm run build` green (emits manifest.webmanifest + sw.js + workbox); `test -x scripts/run_demo.sh` OK; seed idempotent (stable 3/4/120/65/14/28); in-process TestClient happy-path smoke submit->classify(superseded 0.86)->provenance build+verify(ok/tamper flip)->reviewer resolve(closed) PASSED. No git commit (orchestrator publishes). POST-REVIEW FIX PASS (2026-09-07, review 2026-09-07-090713-review.md NEEDS_CHANGES -> resolved): addressed all 8 issues (3 blockers + 5 lesser). (B1) register no longer accepts a role -> forced student (schemas.UserRegister lost role; api/auth.py SELF_REGISTER_ROLE='student'); privileged demo users still seeded; frontend RegisterPage role dropdown removed; new conftest make_user fixture provisions privileged test actors directly; new test asserts a public caller cannot self-assign admin/reviewer/issuer and is 403'd from admin routes. (B2) seed now calls new provenance.build_all_missing_roots() so a fresh demo verifies ok=true (A-2); idempotent (1 root/185 proofs/1 anchor block stable on re-run); new test_fresh_seed_verifies_a_notice. (B3) dataset held-out round (temporal_bucket==1) uses naturalistic phrasings not engineered around the mock cues via _naturalistic_text; metrics now honest (temporal finalsay F1 ~0.05, institution ~0.74, no longer 1.000) with finalsay uniquely at 0.000 false-confirmation rate; harness docstring+report updated; eval sanity tests replaced (lowest-FCR + institution-beats-page_change). (4) leaf_index now positional enumerate index, not leaves.index(); new test. (5) removed dead MockComparisonModel fixtures seam + fixed docstring. (6) POST /api/ingest/submit gated to require_role('student','admin'). (7) sha256_notice now covers deadline/audience/action (labelled canonical form); all callers updated; new tamper test. (8) AlertsPage labelled a clear prototype localStorage stub. VERIFY: backend pytest 50 passed; both eval splits exit 0; seed idempotent twice; npm run build green.
